title: Copper Spamton
description: Now, instead of a copper golem, Spamton from Deltarune will walk around your base
body:
This resource pack replaces the copper golem with **Spamton from the game Deltarune!**
There is a chance that Spamton will not sort your items into chests, **but steal them...** be careful.
![Is a Spamton!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7cf70a9b7fc1919609aae06bb9e530767bb93e50.png)Also, the copper ingot is replaced with **pipis**
